sourceText: Continue executing the canonical role-prompt modularization plan in order until every milestone is DONE. Story 5 migrates concept, quality, test-coverage, behavior, and docs reviewers to trusted full and fail-closed incremental assembly, excludes retired channel, proves preregistered A/B quality and token savings, and preserves permissions, signatures, rollback, and old-pass compatibility.
normalizedOutcome: A user dispatching any of the five active reviewers sees the mechanically selected full or incremental mode and stable reason, can independently roll a role back to exact legacy prompt bytes, and receives an honest per-role replay report with quality verdict and token deltas while retired channel never participates.
acceptanceClaim: All four Story 5 milestones and 48 verification intents pass with five independently reversible reviewer roles, fail-closed full escalation, role-aware preregistered replay, preserved authority and signatures, and no retired-channel gate credit.
